messages:
alice_security: Quick Q for SOC2/ISO thread — we got an auditor ask about a retention exception for KMS-protected artifact snapshots. They want: 1) mapping of which snapshots are excluded from standard 365d retention, 2) rationale, and 3) where the proof-of-deletion / key-rotation link lives. Can ops/infra confirm the list and the export command?
charlie_ops: We have a small set — nightly model checkpoints we keep 13 months for rollback. UUIDs are in the S3 bucket tag `retain:extended`.
charlie_ops: I can export list. will pull keys and last-rotate times.
dana_devex: FYI those snapshots are encrypted with customer-managed key alias `alias/rdw-models-prod`. Auditor wants evidence chain to show key rotation preceded deletion.
bob_auditor: hi team — for SOC2 we need chain-of-custody: snapshot id -> S3 lifecycle exception -> KMS key rotation event id -> deletion event (or lifecycle marker). Timestamped logs suffice. Ideally single ZIP with manifest.
charlie_ops: copying commands i'll run (splunk + aws):
charlie_ops: ```splunk search index=infra sourcetype=s3 "retain:extended" | table _time, bucket, key, snapshot_id```
charlie_ops: ```aws s3api list-object-versions --bucket redwood-prod-models --prefix snapshots/ --query 'Versions[?contains(Key, `snapshot`)]'```
charlie_ops: ```aws cloudtrail lookup-events --lookup-attributes AttributeKey=ResourceName,AttributeValue=alias/rdw-models-prod --max-results 50```
alice_security: @charlie_ops can you include KMS key policy snapshot (redacted) and KMS GenerateDataKey/Encrypt calls for the snapshot objects? Auditor flagged GenerateDataKey as proof-of-encryption step.
charlie_ops: yup. i'll include CloudTrail encrypt/decrypt events and the KMS key rotation history (keyState, rotationStatus).
infra-bot: Note: export job queued (job-id: job-2028-09-14-17). Estimated size ~40MB.
bob_auditor: One more: for ISO we also need to see the exception approval (who approved extended retention) and the risk acceptance doc. PDF or Confluence link ok.
dana_devex: approval is on Confluence -> /ops/retention-exceptions/model-checkpoints-2024. I'll attach.
charlie_ops: exporting now. will produce a manifest.csv with columns: snapshot_id, s3_key, created_at, retention_expires, kms_key_id, kms_last_rotate, deletion_event_id (if any), approver, approval_link.
alice_security: Great. Please redact any customer PII before zipping. Also include hash manifests (sha256) for each log file.
charlie_ops: Will do. ETA in this thread ~2 hours.
bob_auditor: thanks — once you upload, ping me and we'll confirm chain completeness. :thumbsup:
